# API commands: methods and call, which reach any library method by name

## `fptctl api call`

Call METHOD with keyword arguments and print its return value.

METHOD is any name from `fptctl api methods`. --args gives the keyword arguments as a JSON object, in which {"$datetime": "2026-11-10T14:30:00Z"} becomes a datetime. Use it for the methods with no command of their own, such as work_schedule_read.

```text
fptctl api call [OPTIONS] METHOD
```

Options:

- `--args JSON|@FILE|-`: Keyword arguments as a JSON object. {"$datetime": "..."} becomes a datetime. [default: {}]

Examples:

```shell
fptctl api call work_schedule_read --args @dates.json
fptctl api call preferences_read --args '{"prefs": ["format_date_fields"]}'
```

## `fptctl api methods`

List the library's public methods and their signatures.

These are the methods `fptctl api call` can reach. They are read from the installed shotgun_api3 at run time, so a method a newer library adds is reachable with no fptctl change.

```text
fptctl api methods [OPTIONS]
```

Examples:

```shell
fptctl api methods
fptctl --format ndjson api methods
```
